_: PART 29 (P5 — INCOMPLETE-VS-VIOLATION DOMINANCE) ratchet. `known` waives (engine, gate) pairs that
are known-broken, so a real regression elsewhere still fails the suite.
IT RATCHETS BOTH WAYS. An unwaived failure fails the suite; a waiver whose cells now ALL pass also
fails it, so deleting the entry is part of the fix — a waiver that outlives its defect masks the
defect's return.
`known` IS EMPTY, AND THAT IS THE OUTCOME OF A FIX, NOT OF NOTHING BEING FOUND. On its first honest
run this property failed candor-swift on BOTH gates, and the finding was a gate-level cardinal sin:
`Parser.parse` is error-tolerant and never throws, so a file with a syntax error counted as fully
analyzed. Error recovery folds the declarations after the bad token into the broken function's body,
so the effect is MISATTRIBUTED and its real owner vanishes from `functions` — a ⟨0.21⟩ purity claim
over a function that performs Net. Measured, two trees differing by one unparseable declaration:
well-formed        functions: [Hidden.leak -> Net]    `deny Net Hidden`  exit 1
one syntax error   functions: [nope -> Net]           `deny Net Hidden`  exit 0, ok: true
Fixed in candor-swift by consulting `ParseDiagnosticsGenerator` and recording the file in
`unanalyzed` while STILL walking the recovered tree — additive, so no effect is lost.
TWO HARNESS DEFECTS WERE FOUND AND FIXED BEFORE ANY OF THAT WAS BELIEVED, and both would have
produced findings about candor that were really findings about this file: the swift arm passed
`cases.swift` instead of the directory, so `broken.swift` was never scanned and the 'incomplete' arms
were not incomplete; and `find_report` excluded only two of SPEC §2.2's six reserved sidecar
segments, so the ts baseline snapshot resolved to `<prefix>.locs.json` — a sidecar handed to an engine
as a baseline, printing as `ts/baseline CONTROL-DEAD`.
VERIFIED TO CATCH, twice and in two different shapes: the swift defect above (FALSE-GREEN), and a
re-seeded candor-rust ordering defect (NOT-DOMINANT on `rust/baseline` while `rust/policy` stayed
clean, which is the per-gate discrimination this property exists for).
